definitions.explanation: Considering all aspects or the entire scope of something. Used to make broad assessments or summaries rather than commenting on specific details.

examples.japanese: {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧だった。
⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧だ。
examples.english: This year's performance is generally strong.

examples.japanese: {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}える→言う：00515_iu⟧だろう。
examples.english: Looking at it overall, this plan can be called a success.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from ⟦{全般|ぜんぱん}→全般：04383_zenpan⟧ (the whole, everything) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix) + ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (adverbial particle). Often placed at the beginning of a sentence or before a verb/adjective to qualify a broad judgment. The base adjective form {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な can also modify nouns: {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (overall tendency).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧ (looking at it overall)
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{好調|こうちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧ (generally strong/favorable)
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}な⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧ (overall tendency)
- {全般的|ぜんぱんてき}に⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (generally speaking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{概|おおむ}ね→概ね：05732_oomune⟧ (generally, mostly) is similar but slightly more formal. ⟦{総合的|そうごうてき}→総合的：06175_sougouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (comprehensively) emphasizes combining multiple factors into a whole assessment.
